relationships.id_type: uuid
relationships.scope: organization plus assistant; runtime memory also user
relationships.lookup: GET /api/v1/admin/assistants/{id} (Chat source); Knowledge runtime configure/query consumes same assistant UUID

preconditions: Authorized Chat assistant/conversation and current user
Configured Knowledge assistant policy; distinguish missing policy from disabled memory
sequence: Resolve Chat assistant
Configure corresponding Knowledge policy through trusted server boundary
Query bounded Knowledge context with current user
Execute through Agentic
Persist source reply and emit durable ingestion event
Verify accepted ingestion receipt then reconcile processing outcome
workflow.idempotency: Knowledge turn key derives assistant/user/source message; source correction version is a required gap
failure_handling: Do not treat queued:false as ingested
Do not accept HTTP error bodies as success
Recover durable event delivery before advancing ingestion checkpoint
workflow.compensation: Source edits/deletes require versioned correction/tombstone propagation; currently tracked gap

relationships.id_type: uuid note_id plus integer version; project UUID is Task domain
relationships.scope: Task workspace maps to organization; selected Task projects and current local grants
relationships.lookup: Task GET /api/v1/work-items/{id}; internal projection candidate/version manifest

preconditions: TASK_KNOWLEDGE_ENABLED and dedicated server token configured
Current Task actor may read selected projects and individual note
sequence: Task queues source version
Worker sends current note/tombstone to Knowledge sync
Search returns candidate IDs/versions
Task reloads and authorizes source
Request only authorized exact-version passages
Task rechecks source access/version before returning evidence
workflow.idempotency: Organization/note primary key with monotonic version and same-version checksum
failure_handling: Direct selected fresh note may fall back to bounded current source text
Never return revoked source IDs from internal ranking metadata
workflow.compensation: Newer delete projection blanks text; current Task read checks exclude deleted/revoked sources even before indexing catches up

relationships.id_type: uuid distinct conversation_id and agentic_thread_id
relationships.scope: Current Chat membership plus Agentic execution permissions
relationships.lookup: Chat GET /api/v1/conversations/{id}; Agentic POST /api/v1/chat/threads for creation

preconditions: AI conversation and valid permitted model/billing policy
sequence: Create or recover linked Agentic thread
Persist Agentic thread ID on Chat conversation
Retrieve governed context
Invoke Agentic run and forward stable events
Persist Chat assistant message and Agentic usage receipt
workflow.idempotency: Chat AI turn and message client IDs require retry/reconnect verification
failure_handling: Preserve partial run and SSE recovery behavior from Pastil
No history fetch cancellation of active runs
workflow.compensation: Cross-service thread creation and conversation save are not one transaction; orphan/retry reconciliation requires verification

relationships.id_type: Control project slug string → Version service slug; service/release UUIDs are Version identities
relationships.scope: Control sandbox namespace and namespace-local publisher Secret; never select by remembered user/project role
relationships.cardinality: one sandbox project to catalog service; many version-name release records
relationships.lookup: POST /api/v1/apk/releases returns release UUID; GET /api/v1/services/{service_slug} and /api/v1/versions/{version_id} verify metadata

preconditions: Current Control project authorization and exact sandbox namespace
Version deployment present and namespace-local publisher credential installed
APK bytes available at the intended HTTPS URL
sequence: Build and upload APK
Provision/reuse sandbox Secret and preserve binding on reconciliation
Publish bounded metadata using server-only token
Validate raw receipt and durable terminal outcome
Read back exact release UUID and service slug, compare code/URL and verify bytes
workflow.idempotency: Version local per-slug transaction protects repeated and concurrent publication; Control job receipt/reconciliation is still unverified
failure_handling: Distinguish build/upload success from catalog publication
Local script now validates receipt/read-back and retains partial-outcome identity; durable Control storage/reconciliation remains pending.
workflow.compensation: Preserve prior published release; reconcile upload/catalog partial outcomes without deleting history

relationships.id_type: project_slug plus authenticated user UUID
relationships.scope: Current Agentic project settings-manage authority, distinct from remembered permissions
relationships.lookup: GET /api/v1/projects/{slug}/admin/status on configured internal Agentic origin
relationships.meaning: Actual Manage process reads current Agentic settings-manage authority through signed nonce/user-bound receipts; Mongo membership, identity and service revocation survive Manage restart.29 local checks passed; Control lifecycle is fixture-backed and deployed gateway/IDP/Control remain unverified. Canonical source decision remains open.

relationships.id_type: thread UUID or ask/action UUID plus project slug
relationships.scope: Signed Manage project, authenticated user; Agentic owns execution/billing and action lifecycle
relationships.lookup: Exact allowlisted /api/v1/agent methods map to Agentic chat/threads, ide thread messages/stream/cancel/delete, ask complete and browser action complete
relationships.meaning: Streaming narrow bridge preserves execution authority. Verify cross-project thread access, current membership revocation, stale/duplicate/expired review decisions and actual receipts before enabling final Manage knowledge.
